hints.title: Bounded Coordinate Search Space
hints.text: All input coordinates are constrained between 1 and 100, permitting exhaustive examination of origin points.

hints.title: Manhattan Distance Radius
hints.text: For a chosen origin (x, y), calculate the Manhattan distance |x - px| + |y - py| to each given virus point.

hints.title: K-th Smallest Distance Evaluation
hints.text: Sort distances and record the k-th smallest distance; find the global minimum across all valid grid coordinates.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Grid sweep evaluating k-th smallest Manhattan distance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Continuous geometric Fermat-Weber algorithms are overcomplicated for small discrete coordinate grids.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since coordinate bounds are strictly 100x100 and N <= 16, grid enumeration takes under 200,000 operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that small coordinate limits allow discrete grid enumeration.

solutions.approach: Grid coordinate search with nth_element in C++
